title: Kubernetes Cluster
description: Which node is unhealthy and why, how full the cluster is, and whether the API is healthy.

links.title: Alert rules
links.tooltip: Grafana-managed alert rules and their state

panels.title: Ready nodes
panels.description: Nodes reporting Ready in the selected node pools.

targets.expr: sum(kube_node_status_condition{cluster=~"$cluster",condition="Ready",status="true"} * on (cluster, node) group_left() max by (cluster, node) (kube_node_labels{cluster=~"$cluster",label_karpenter_sh_nodepool=~"$nodepool"}))

panels.title: NotReady
panels.description: Ready can remain true during a short node stall; also inspect host memory, PSI, and scrape failures.

targets.expr: sum(kube_node_status_condition{cluster=~"$cluster",condition="Ready",status=~"false|unknown"} * on (cluster, node) group_left() max by (cluster, node) (kube_node_labels{cluster=~"$cluster",label_karpenter_sh_nodepool=~"$nodepool"})) or vector(0)

panels.title: Cordoned
panels.description: Nodes marked unschedulable. Auto Mode cordons a node while it drains it for replacement.

targets.expr: sum(kube_node_spec_unschedulable{cluster=~"$cluster"} * on (cluster, node) group_left() max by (cluster, node) (kube_node_labels{cluster=~"$cluster",label_karpenter_sh_nodepool=~"$nodepool"})) or vector(0)

panels.title: Pressure
panels.description: Nodes reporting MemoryPressure, DiskPressure or PIDPressure. One node is counted once.

panels.title: Failed targets
panels.description: Core monitoring targets with at least one failed scrape in the last 5 minutes; this is not the number of nodes.

panels.title: Restarts 10m
panels.description: Cluster-wide count across all namespaces. A last termination reason of Completed does not hide a liveness restart.

targets.expr: sum(sum by (cluster, node) ((increase(kube_pod_container_status_restarts_total{cluster=~"$cluster"}[10m]) or increase(kube_pod_init_container_status_restarts_total{cluster=~"$cluster"}[10m])) * on (cluster, namespace, pod) group_left(node) topk by (cluster, namespace, pod) (1, max by (cluster, namespace, pod, node) (kube_pod_info{cluster=~"$cluster"})))) or vector(0)

panels.title: Liveness fails
panels.description: Failed liveness checks in the last 5 minutes. Zero is supplied only for a successfully scraped kubelet probes endpoint.

targets.expr: sum(sum by (cluster, instance) (increase(prober_probe_total{cluster=~"$cluster",probe_type="Liveness",result="failed"}[5m])) or on (cluster, instance) (0 * max by (cluster, instance) (up{cluster=~"$cluster",job="kubelet",metrics_path="/metrics/probes"} == 1))) or vector(0)

panels.title: Namespaces
panels.description: Active namespaces.

panels.title: CPU requests
panels.description: CPU requests of containers and running init/native sidecar containers / allocatable CPU. Scheduling reservation only; Auto Mode adds nodes when pods cannot be scheduled.

targets.expr:
sum((kube_pod_container_resource_requests{resource=~"cpu"} or (kube_pod_init_container_resource_requests{resource=~"cpu"} and on(cluster,namespace,pod,container) (kube_pod_init_container_status_running == 1))) * on (cluster, node) group_left (role) kube_node_labels{cluster=~"$cluster",label_karpenter_sh_nodepool=~"$nodepool"}) /
sum(kube_node_status_allocatable{resource=~"cpu"} * on (cluster, node) group_left (role) kube_node_labels{cluster=~"$cluster",label_karpenter_sh_nodepool=~"$nodepool"}) * 100

panels.title: Memory requests
panels.description: Scheduling reservation only. Kernel memory, page cache, and usage above requests are not represented.

targets.expr:
sum((kube_pod_container_resource_requests{resource=~"memory"} or (kube_pod_init_container_resource_requests{resource=~"memory"} and on(cluster,namespace,pod,container) (kube_pod_init_container_status_running == 1))) * on (cluster, node) group_left (role) kube_node_labels{cluster=~"$cluster",label_karpenter_sh_nodepool=~"$nodepool"}) /
sum(kube_node_status_allocatable{resource=~"memory"} * on (cluster, node) group_left (role) kube_node_labels{cluster=~"$cluster",label_karpenter_sh_nodepool=~"$nodepool"}) * 100

panels.title: Pod slots
panels.description: Scheduled pods / allocatable pod slots. Each node has a fixed pod limit that depends on instance type.

targets.expr:
sum(kube_pod_info{cluster=~"$cluster"} * on (cluster, node) group_left (role) kube_node_labels{cluster=~"$cluster",label_karpenter_sh_nodepool=~"$nodepool"}) /
sum(kube_node_status_allocatable{resource=~"pods"} * on (cluster, node) group_left (role) kube_node_labels{cluster=~"$cluster",label_karpenter_sh_nodepool=~"$nodepool"}) * 100

panels.title: Host CPU max
panels.description: Worst node CPU busy percentage. CPU pressure and load trends are shown below.

panels.title: Host mem max
panels.description: Worst measured host memory usage, including kernel memory. Check failed targets before treating absent node data as recovery.

targets.expr: 100 - (min(100 * max by (cluster, instance) (node_memory_MemAvailable_bytes{job="node-exporter",cluster=~"$cluster",instance=~"$instance"}) / max by (cluster, instance) (node_memory_MemTotal_bytes{job="node-exporter",cluster=~"$cluster",instance=~"$instance"})))

panels.title: Kernel / RAM
panels.description: Includes kernel BPF map allocations. Sustained growth can exhaust a node while pod memory looks normal.

targets.expr: max(100 * max by (cluster, instance) (node_memory_VmallocUsed_bytes{job="node-exporter",cluster=~"$cluster",instance=~"$instance"}) / max by (cluster, instance) (node_memory_MemTotal_bytes{job="node-exporter",cluster=~"$cluster",instance=~"$instance"}))

panels.title: Disk max
panels.description: Worst writable root/data filesystem usage; readonly OS images are excluded.

panels.title: CPU: used · requested · allocatable
panels.description: Cluster CPU cores. Used is container usage (cAdvisor); requested is what the scheduler reserves; allocatable is node capacity available to pods.

targets.expr: sum(kube_pod_container_resource_requests{cluster=~"$cluster",resource="cpu"} * on (cluster, namespace, pod) group_left() (max by (cluster, namespace, pod) (kube_pod_status_phase{cluster=~"$cluster",phase=~"Pending|Running"}) == 1))

panels.title: Memory: used · requested · allocatable
panels.description: Cluster memory. Used is container working set; requested is reserved by pods; allocatable is node capacity available to pods.

targets.expr: sum(kube_pod_container_resource_requests{cluster=~"$cluster",resource="memory"} * on (cluster, namespace, pod) group_left() (max by (cluster, namespace, pod) (kube_pod_status_phase{cluster=~"$cluster",phase=~"Pending|Running"}) == 1))

panels.title: Nodes
panels.description: One row per node in the selected pools. Host CPU, memory and disk come from node-exporter; requests are Pending/Running pod requests over allocatable. Auto Mode adds nodes when requests do not fit, so high request ratios are normal. A dash means the node has no node-exporter (for example a runner node).

targets.expr: max by (node, label_karpenter_sh_nodepool, label_node_kubernetes_io_instance_type, label_topology_kubernetes_io_zone, label_karpenter_sh_capacity_type) (kube_node_labels{cluster=~"$cluster",label_karpenter_sh_nodepool=~"$nodepool"})

100 * sum by (node) (kube_pod_container_resource_requests{cluster=~"$cluster",resource="cpu"} * on (cluster, namespace, pod) group_left() (max by (cluster, namespace, pod) (kube_pod_status_phase{cluster=~"$cluster",phase=~"Pending|Running"}) == 1)) / max by (node) (kube_node_status_allocatable{cluster=~"$cluster",resource="cpu"})

100 * sum by (node) (kube_pod_container_resource_requests{cluster=~"$cluster",resource="memory"} * on (cluster, namespace, pod) group_left() (max by (cluster, namespace, pod) (kube_pod_status_phase{cluster=~"$cluster",phase=~"Pending|Running"}) == 1)) / max by (node) (kube_node_status_allocatable{cluster=~"$cluster",resource="memory"})

count by (node) (max by (cluster, namespace, pod, node) (kube_pod_info{cluster=~"$cluster"}) * on (cluster, namespace, pod) group_left() (max by (cluster, namespace, pod) (kube_pod_status_phase{cluster=~"$cluster",phase=~"Pending|Running"}) == 1))

panels.title: NodePool cpu vs limit
panels.description: Node cpu per NodePool against its spec.limits. Karpenter cannot grow a pool past 100%, so pods that need it stay Pending. NodePoolNearLimit warns above 90% for 15 minutes. Pools without this limit, or without nodes, are not shown.

targets.expr: 100 * sum by (nodepool) (label_replace(kube_node_status_capacity{cluster=~"$cluster",resource="cpu"} * on (cluster, node) group_left(label_karpenter_sh_nodepool) max by (cluster, node, label_karpenter_sh_nodepool) (kube_node_labels{cluster=~"$cluster"}), "nodepool", "$1", "label_karpenter_sh_nodepool", "(.+)")) / on (nodepool) group_left() max by (nodepool) (karpenter_nodepool_limit{cluster=~"$cluster",resource="cpu"})

panels.title: NodePool memory vs limit
panels.description: Node memory per NodePool against its spec.limits. Karpenter cannot grow a pool past 100%, so pods that need it stay Pending. NodePoolNearLimit warns above 90% for 15 minutes. Pools without this limit, or without nodes, are not shown.

targets.expr: 100 * sum by (nodepool) (label_replace(kube_node_status_capacity{cluster=~"$cluster",resource="memory"} * on (cluster, node) group_left(label_karpenter_sh_nodepool) max by (cluster, node, label_karpenter_sh_nodepool) (kube_node_labels{cluster=~"$cluster"}), "nodepool", "$1", "label_karpenter_sh_nodepool", "(.+)")) / on (nodepool) group_left() max by (nodepool) (karpenter_nodepool_limit{cluster=~"$cluster",resource="memory"})

panels.title: NodePool nodes vs limit
panels.description: Node nodes per NodePool against its spec.limits. Karpenter cannot grow a pool past 100%, so pods that need it stay Pending. NodePoolNearLimit warns above 90% for 15 minutes. Pools without this limit, or without nodes, are not shown.

targets.expr: 100 * count by (nodepool) (label_replace(max by (cluster, node, label_karpenter_sh_nodepool) (kube_node_labels{cluster=~"$cluster"}), "nodepool", "$1", "label_karpenter_sh_nodepool", "(.+)")) / on (nodepool) group_left() max by (nodepool) (karpenter_nodepool_limit{cluster=~"$cluster",resource="nodes"})

panels.title: Nodes by pool
panels.description: Ready nodes per Karpenter node pool. Steps show Auto Mode scaling and replacements.

panels.title: Nodes by instance type
panels.description: Ready nodes per EC2 instance type.

panels.title: Capacity type
panels.description: Spot vs on-demand nodes.

panels.title: Availability zone
panels.description: Ready nodes per zone.

panels.title: Node churn
panels.description: Nodes launched in the trailing hour against fleet size. Auto Mode replaces nodes for drift and expiry.

panels.title: Nodes needing attention — current host values
panels.description: Sort by memory usage to identify the affected instance. Host metrics remain available independently of kube-state-metrics.

targets.expr: (100 - (100 * max by (cluster, instance) (node_memory_MemAvailable_bytes{job="node-exporter",cluster=~"$cluster",instance=~"$instance"}) / max by (cluster, instance) (node_memory_MemTotal_bytes{job="node-exporter",cluster=~"$cluster",instance=~"$instance"}))) * on(cluster,instance) group_left(node) group by(cluster,instance,node)(up{job="node-exporter",cluster=~"$cluster",instance=~"$instance"})

(100 * max by (cluster, instance) (node_memory_VmallocUsed_bytes{job="node-exporter",cluster=~"$cluster",instance=~"$instance"}) / max by (cluster, instance) (node_memory_MemTotal_bytes{job="node-exporter",cluster=~"$cluster",instance=~"$instance"})) * on(cluster,instance) group_left(node) group by(cluster,instance,node)(up{job="node-exporter",cluster=~"$cluster",instance=~"$instance"})

(max by (cluster, instance) (node_load1{job="node-exporter",cluster=~"$cluster",instance=~"$instance"}) / count by (cluster, instance) (max by (cluster, instance, cpu) (node_cpu_seconds_total{job="node-exporter",cluster=~"$cluster",instance=~"$instance",mode="idle"}))) * on(cluster,instance) group_left(node) group by(cluster,instance,node)(up{job="node-exporter",cluster=~"$cluster",instance=~"$instance"})

panels.title: API requests by code
panels.description: Kubernetes API request rate by HTTP code. 429 means API priority and fairness is shedding load.

panels.title: API p99 latency by verb
panels.description: p99 latency of non-streaming API requests by verb (SLI histogram: webhook and queue time excluded).

panels.title: etcd mean latency — slowest operations
panels.description: API server view of etcd latency (the EKS control plane hides etcd itself). Mean per operation from _sum/_count; the per-bucket histogram is dropped at scrape to save about 29k series.

panels.title: Host Memory Available by Instance
panels.description: Percentage of host memory still available (MemAvailable / MemTotal) per node. The warning alert fires below 15% and the critical alert below 8%.

targets.expr: 100 * max by (cluster, instance) (node_memory_MemAvailable_bytes{job="node-exporter",cluster=~"$cluster",instance=~"$instance"}) / max by (cluster, instance) (node_memory_MemTotal_bytes{job="node-exporter",cluster=~"$cluster",instance=~"$instance"})

panels.title: Kernel Vmalloc by Instance
panels.description: Kernel virtual allocations backed by memory, including BPF hash maps. Look for growth across hours or days; not equivalent to pod RSS.

panels.title: Memory / I/O Stall Time (PSI)
panels.description: Percentage of wall time with tasks stalled on memory or I/O. Missing PSI is not a zero.

panels.title: Swap In / Out by Instance
panels.description: Pages per second. Swap activity can indicate host pressure even when Kubernetes MemoryPressure stays false.

panels.title: Load per CPU Core
panels.description: Runnable and uninterruptible tasks per CPU core; includes I/O waits, unlike CPU utilization.

targets.expr: max by (cluster, instance) (node_load1{job="node-exporter",cluster=~"$cluster",instance=~"$instance"}) / count by (cluster, instance) (max by (cluster, instance, cpu) (node_cpu_seconds_total{job="node-exporter",cluster=~"$cluster",instance=~"$instance",mode="idle"}))

panels.title: Liveness Failures by Instance (5m)
panels.description: Failed liveness checks per kubelet over 5 minutes. Failures spread across several pods on one node point to the node; failures on one pod point to the application.

targets.expr: sum by (cluster, instance) (increase(prober_probe_total{cluster=~"$cluster",probe_type="Liveness",result="failed"}[5m])) or on (cluster, instance) (0 * max by (cluster, instance) (up{cluster=~"$cluster",job="kubelet",metrics_path="/metrics/probes"} == 1))

panels.title: Core Target Scrape Health
panels.description: 1 = successful scrape, 0 = failure, gap = missing samples. Includes both API servers and worker monitoring endpoints.

panels.title: Container Restarts by Node (10m)
panels.description: Container restarts per node over 10 minutes. The node alert fires when 3 or more different containers restart on one node within 10 minutes.

targets.expr: sum by (cluster, node) ((increase(kube_pod_container_status_restarts_total{cluster=~"$cluster"}[10m]) or increase(kube_pod_init_container_status_restarts_total{cluster=~"$cluster"}[10m])) * on (cluster, namespace, pod) group_left(node) topk by (cluster, namespace, pod) (1, max by (cluster, namespace, pod, node) (kube_pod_info{cluster=~"$cluster"})))

panels.title: Kernel Vmalloc / Physical RAM
panels.description: Kernel vmalloc as a share of physical RAM per node. The alert fires above 20% for 15 minutes.

targets.expr: 100 * max by (cluster, instance) (node_memory_VmallocUsed_bytes{job="node-exporter",cluster=~"$cluster",instance=~"$instance"}) / max by (cluster, instance) (node_memory_MemTotal_bytes{job="node-exporter",cluster=~"$cluster",instance=~"$instance"})

panels.title: Major Page Faults by Instance
panels.description: Major faults per second require fetching pages; correlate with swap activity and memory PSI.

panels.title: Writable Root / Local Disk Used
panels.description: Worst writable root/data filesystem per node; readonly OS images are excluded.

panels.title: Physical Network I/O
panels.description: Physical interfaces only; pod veth interfaces are excluded to avoid counting traffic twice.

targets.expr: sum by (cluster, instance) (max by (cluster, instance, device) (rate(node_network_receive_bytes_total{cluster=~"$cluster",instance=~"$instance",device=~"eth[0-9]+|en[opsx].*"}[2m])))
sum by (cluster, instance) (max by (cluster, instance, device) (rate(node_network_transmit_bytes_total{cluster=~"$cluster",instance=~"$instance",device=~"eth[0-9]+|en[opsx].*"}[2m])))

panels.title: Network Errors / Drops
panels.description: Receive plus transmit errors and drops per second on physical interfaces. Sustained non-zero values point to the node network or ENA driver.

targets.expr: sum by (cluster, instance) (max by (cluster, instance, device) (rate(node_network_receive_errs_total{cluster=~"$cluster",instance=~"$instance",device=~"eth[0-9]+|en[opsx].*"}[2m]))) + sum by (cluster, instance) (max by (cluster, instance, device) (rate(node_network_transmit_errs_total{cluster=~"$cluster",instance=~"$instance",device=~"eth[0-9]+|en[opsx].*"}[2m])))

sum by (cluster, instance) (max by (cluster, instance, device) (rate(node_network_receive_drop_total{cluster=~"$cluster",instance=~"$instance",device=~"eth[0-9]+|en[opsx].*"}[2m]))) + sum by (cluster, instance) (max by (cluster, instance, device) (rate(node_network_transmit_drop_total{cluster=~"$cluster",instance=~"$instance",device=~"eth[0-9]+|en[opsx].*"}[2m])))

panels.title: Active alerts
panels.description: Live alert state across this monitoring scope; independent of the resource selectors above. Includes pending, firing, collection errors and missing data.
